page.notes: The left part of the scan is a dark gutter and blank area with show-through, and the right edge of the text is cut off, so some line ends are incomplete. Doubtful readings: the page number and several italic/roman boundaries in the entries; "Iereum" may be "Pereum" or "Lereum"; "Hasdrubalis" line end is cut. The bracketed block of notes and the Equus brace are read from the visible portion only. Page is cut off at the bottom; margin figures 10 to 50 and the Forum bracket are as printed. Some readings in the marginal and bracketed entries are doubtful.
